quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (January-June) results, non-GAAP (timing business excluded from February 2026): revenue JPY 7,776 hundred million, +22.8% YoY, on higher demand and the rebound from last year's channel inventory adjustment. Automotive revenue JPY 3,587 hundred million (+13.4%), gross margin 55.7%, operating profit JPY 1,261 hundred million (35.1% margin, +50.8%); Industrial/Infrastructure/IoT revenue JPY 4,122 hundred million (+38.1%, mainly higher data-center demand plus recovery in industrial and IoT markets), gross margin 61.3%, operating profit JPY 1,318 hundred million (32.0% margin, +96.4%). Group gross margin 58.6% (+1.8pts, better product mix and higher utilization); operating profit JPY 2,582 hundred million, 33.2% margin (+5.5pts). IFRS: revenue JPY 7,987 hundred million (+25.9%), operating profit JPY 1,927 hundred million (24.1% margin).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 non-GAAP revenue JPY 7,776 hundred million (+22.8%); Industrial/Infrastructure/IoT JPY 4,122 hundred million (+38.1%); OP JPY 2,582 hundred million (33.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capex plan: the company has now fixed its investment for the first three quarters of 2026 (January-September, investment-decision basis, property, plant and equipment plus intangibles) at a planned total of about JPY 1,410 hundred million, mainly to raise production capacity for AI semiconductors and to strengthen design and development. H1 2026 R&D spending (including capitalised development costs) was JPY 1,257 hundred million.
